metamorphosis.definition: A big change of shape. A caterpillar turning into a butterfly is metamorphosis.
metamorphosis.example: You can watch metamorphosis happen in a garden.

spec_scope.definition: The area of work that a person, a document or a decision covers.
spec_scope.example: The scope of this decision covers the money, the contract and the customer.

thicket.definition: A thick, tangled mass of bushes. You cannot see far into a thicket.
thicket.example: A small voice came out of the thicket.
